system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
The Seller’s update and Disclosure Letter are **proposals, not agreed protections**. The buyer should reject any drafting that treats disclosure, knowledge, or a general limitation clause as automatically defeating the protections below.

| Issue | Seller’s position | What the buyer should want | Recommendation — one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001 General liability cap** | General Warranty Claims capped at **20% / AUD 4.8m**. | A materially higher cap: seek **100% of price**, with **50%** a potential negotiated floor if other protections remain strong. | **Reject 20%** — it leaves the buyer bearing most loss from a significant warranty breach. |
| **SPA-N-002 De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 per claim; AUD 250,000 **excess-only** basket. | Lower de minimis and a lower **first-dollar (tipping)** basket; related claims should aggregate. | **Counter with AUD 10,000 and AUD 100,000 first-dollar basket** — the proposal excludes too much recoverable loss. |
| **SPA-N-003 General claims time limit** | Notice within **18 months**; limitations presumed to cover all Claims. | At least **24–36 months** for general warranties, with distinct periods for other claim categories. | **Seek 36 months and category-specific periods** — material issues may emerge after 18 months. |
| **SPA-N-004 Fundamental/Title regime** | Same cap and time limit as general warranties. | Separate title/capacity protection, capped at no less than **100% of price**, with a substantially longer claim period. | **Reject the general regime for fundamental claims** — ownership of the shares is the core bargain. |
| **SPA-N-005 Fraud carve-out** | “All Claims” limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance wording could capture fraud; no express exception is offered. | Express preservation of fraud, dishonesty and deliberate concealment claims, without contractual caps, baskets, time bars or non-reliance defences. | **Insist on an express carve-out** — broad limitations must not shelter intentional misconduct. |
| **SPA-N-006 Disclosure scope** | Blanket disclosure of the data room, accounts, registers and public records. | Only **specific, fair disclosure** with enough detail to identify the nature and scope of the matter; no blanket data-room or public-record disclosure. | **Reject general disclosure** — making documents available is not the same as clearly disclosing an exception to a warranty. |
| **SPA-N-007 Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for matters known by buyer or advisers, including anything discoverable in documents or records. | No general knowledge exclusion; if unavoidable, limit it to **actual knowledge of named buyer deal principals**, not deemed or adviser knowledge, and preserve fraud and specific indemnities. | **Delete the proposed qualifier** — it would transfer the burden of imperfect disclosure to the buyer. |
| **SPA-N-008 Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; condition satisfied by delivery of written consent. Final consent and evidence of clause 11.3 conditions are absent. | A completion condition requiring effective written consent **and satisfaction or waiver of all associated conditions**, in form acceptable to buyer; buyer alone may waive. | **Do not complete without the full consent package** — Bluefen represents about **30% of FY26 revenue**. |
| **SPA-N-009 Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m debt and security to be released **after** Completion. | Debt repaid from seller proceeds **at Completion**, with bank payout confirmation and effective release/discharge of all security as completion deliverables. | **Reject post-Completion release** — the debt-free/cash-free deal must not leave buyer exposed to lender claims or security. |
| **SPA-N-010 Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 conditional Completion bonuses omitted from funds flow; seller treats them as its matter. | Identify who owes them and when; seller funds or price-adjusts for bonuses **and applicable payroll tax, superannuation and on-costs**, without double counting. | **Correct the funds flow before signing** — a Completion-triggered cost must not silently reduce buyer value. |
| **SPA-N-011 Ironquay IP indemnity** | Existing indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; AUD 180,000 remains open and no payment receipt or assignment is supplied. | Seller to procure cleared payment and confirmatory assignment/chain-of-title evidence; specific indemnity for **all losses from defective SOW3 IP ownership or use**, outside general limitations. | **Expand the indemnity and require cure evidence** — paying the invoice alone may not establish transferable IP title. |
| **SPA-N-012 Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary, not expected to be material; access, scope and notification requirements remain unconfirmed. | Completed investigation, preservation and remediation evidence, legal notification assessment, update covenant, and a tailored indemnity/escrow if exposure remains unresolved. | **Keep this open** — neither a confirmed breach nor absence of loss can yet be assumed. |
| **SPA-N-013 Sandbar renewals** | Three AUD 110,000 renewals characterised as ordinary-course costs. | Review all three together for commitments, termination rights, timing and accrual; reflect any pre-Completion liability or non-ordinary commitment in price mechanics or seller protection. | **Do not accept the characterisation without evidence** — aggregate exposure is **AUD 330,000**, and its nature is unresolved. |
| **SPA-N-014 Category separation** | Caps, time limits, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to **all Claims** unless expressly excepted. | Distinct regimes for general warranties, fundamental/title, tax, IP, specific indemnities, covenants and fraud; no accidental cross-application. | **Redraft limitations by claim category** — “all Claims” language could neutralise negotiated protections. |
| **SPA-N-015 Title verification** | DD-012 share register records Seller as holder of 100% of issued shares. | Verify issued capital, legal and beneficial ownership, encumbrances, constitution, relevant corporate records and transfer deliverables; obtain robust title warranties. | **Treat the register as evidence, not conclusive diligence** — it does not by itself prove unencumbered title. |
| **SPA-N-016 Tax/IP open terms** | Tax and IP warranties said to be settled under the general cap and 18-month regime. | Dedicated, substantive tax and IP warranties; tax covenant/indemnity with a period aligned to assessment risk, and separate protection for material IP ownership and infringement exposure. | **Reopen both regimes** — the proposed general terms are ill-suited to longer-tail tax and IP risk. |

**Priority before signing:** resolve Bluefen consent, Riverlark payoff/release, Ironquay IP title, Completion bonuses and the incident investigation; none is fully closed by the Disclosure Letter.
=== END ADVICE ===
